name: 311 Call Center Inquiry
description: Please note: Due to pandemic call handling modifications, the activity data since March 2020 does not fully represent the agent-handled calls to 311. The actual calls handled are higher. The 311 Call Center Inquiry dataset contains information on all agent-handled calls to the City’s 311 information line, including date, time and topic. Click here for the data dictionary.
